summary: Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing large-scale pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and secure data solutions using Python, PySpark, and SQL on AWS. Proficient in batch and real-time streaming using AWS Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, and EMR, with expertise in S3-based Data Lakes, Redshift, and Terraform CI/CD. Experienced in data modeling and pipeline development across security and healthcare domains with advanced analytics.

highlights: Architected and maintained AWS Glue and EMR pipelines processing 1TB of daily cybersecurity logs from S3 for threat detection.
Automated AWS Glue orchestration workflows for 10+ ETL pipelines with 5 concurrent executions, ensuring zero dependency failures.
Developed modular, parameterized PySpark scripts to standardize data cleansing and accelerate new telemetry source onboarding.
Optimized storage and compute using S3 partitioning, Glue job bookmarks, and columnar formats, reducing AWS compute costs by 20%.
Managed AWS IAM and Lake Formation policies via Terraform, enforcing role-based access controls (RBAC) across teams.
Accelerated ETL pipeline development using GenAI tools (GitHub Copilot), reducing AWS deployment time from 10 days to 7 days.
Monitored pipeline health and data quality metrics using CloudWatch, providing timely resolutions to ensure SLA compliance.
Developed ETL pipelines integrating raw operational datasets into analytics-ready layers in S3 and Redshift using AWS Glue.
Migrated complex T-SQL stored procedures to distributed PySpark workflows on EMR, reducing batch processing time by 30 mins/run.
Designed metadata-driven ingestion frameworks using AWS Glue Data Catalog to support scalable onboarding of new data sources.
Built Python REST API ingestion frameworks with Lambda, retry logic, and pagination, reducing integration time from weeks to days.
Constructed multi-dimensional data models (fact and dimension tables) in Redshift to support BI dashboards and reporting.
Established automated data quality checks using Python and AWS Glue to detect schema drift and prevent corrupted downstream.
Partnered with BI analysts to design and deliver optimized Redshift tables, powering operational dashboards and reducing query latency.

projects.title: Security Log Analytics and Threat Detection Platform (AWS)
highlights: Engineered scalable data pipelines using AWS Glue and EMR to ingest and process security data from simulated S3 sources.
Developed transformation workflows with PySpark and stored curated datasets in S3 using Parquet and Delta formats.
Architected medallion architecture to enable operational analytics and support historical reporting workflows with automation.
Implemented data validation checks and CloudWatch monitoring logic to assess pipeline reliability and ensure data quality in production.

projects.title: Hybrid Healthcare Data Engineering Pipeline (FHIR → Medallion → RBAC)
highlights: Engineered end-to-end medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) ingesting synthetic FHIR JSON bundles using PySpark.
Designed a hybrid ingestion system combining PySpark batch processing and real-time Kafka streaming via Docker.
Modeled a Kimball methodology with facts and dimensions for Claims analytics, using MD5 surrogate keys to maintain integrity.
Implemented HIPAA compliance with PHI hashing and generalization, enforcing RBAC within PostgreSQL as a data warehouse.

projects.title: Universal AI Assistant Chrome Extension (AI Vibecoded)
highlights: Leveraged AI pair-programming to rapidly architect, iterate, and deploy a complex Chrome extension integrating ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini natively into the browser.
Implemented Chrome's sidePanel API to create a seamless, persistent chat experience featuring automatic session-cookie sharing.
Built a dynamic, floating UI component that calculates getBoundingClientRect to seamlessly render action buttons next to user text selections.
